1. A customer is identified by a unique customer identifier and has a KYC status that is either VERIFIED, PENDING, or FAILED.
2. A customer has an account tier that is one of STANDARD, PLUS, PREMIUM, or BUSINESS.
3. A customer has a vulnerable flag that is either true or false.
4. A customer has a politically exposed person flag that is either true or false.
5. A customer has a sanctions flag that is either true or false.
6. A customer has a field named recent dispute count which is a non-negative integer maintained by the runtime.
7. A customer has a field named recent goodwill credit total which is a non-negative amount in pence maintained by the runtime.
8. A customer has a field named has previously failed documentation request which is a boolean maintained by the runtime.
9. An account is identified by a unique account identifier and belongs to exactly one customer.
10. An account has a status that is one of ACTIVE, FROZEN, CLOSED, or RESTRICTED.
